enableQuarry.Name: Automate Hunter's Quarry
enableQuarry.Hint: Using Hunter's Quarry tags the nearest visible enemy (or your target) and offers the extra damage in the damage dialog, once per turn.

enableCurse.Name: Automate Warlock's Curse
enableCurse.Hint: Using Warlock's Curse tags the nearest visible enemy (or your target) and offers the extra damage in the damage dialog, once per turn. Star Pact warlocks get Fate of the Void when a cursed enemy drops.

enableRage.Name: Automate Barbarian rages
enableRage.Hint: Using a rage power puts the barbarian in that rage until the end of the encounter (ending the previous one) and offers rage-dependent damage bonuses.

enableMarks.Name: Automate marks
enableMarks.Hint: Powers like Misdirected Mark apply the mark to hit targets. Marks use the system's mark status, so the -2 penalty is applied by the dnd4e system.

enableCover.Name: Automatic cover
enableCover.Hint: Compute cover and superior cover (corner-to-corner lines) and tick them in the attack dialog. Area attacks are not automated.

warnNotNearest.Name: Warn when the target isn't the nearest enemy
warnNotNearest.Hint: For Hunter's Quarry and Warlock's Curse.

coverPreview.Name: Cover preview lines
coverPreview.Hint: While you target a token, draw the cover lines from your token. Only you see them.

preloadIndexes.Name: Preload compendium indexes
preloadIndexes.Hint: Load compendium indexes in the background when the game starts, so the first character sheet you open doesn't stall for a few seconds.

debug.Name: Debug logging
debug.Hint: Write diagnostic messages to the browser console.

gameLanguage.Name: 4e game language
gameLanguage.Hint: Language for the dnd4e system (abilities, skills, conditions, sheet labels) and this module, independent of Foundry's interface language. Strings missing from the translation stay in Foundry's language. Requires reload.

actionTracker.Name: Action Tracker
actionTracker.Hint: Track standard, move, minor, immediate and opportunity actions per turn. Using a power spends its action (with trades). Shows pips in the Combat Tracker.

actionPanel.Name: Open the action panel in combat
actionPanel.Hint: Open the floating action panel automatically when a combat starts.

actionWarnings.Name: Warn on overspent actions
actionWarnings.Hint: Show a warning when an action is used that isn't available (the action still goes through).

tokenBadges.Name: Quarry/curse/mark badges on tokens
tokenBadges.Hint: Show a large coloured badge with the source's portrait on the top-right of marked tokens.

dockPips.Name: Action pips on Combat Tracker Dock
dockPips.Hint: Show the action pips on each portrait of the Combat Tracker Dock module, if it is active.

opportunityAttacks.Name: Opportunity attack prompts
opportunityAttacks.Hint: When an enemy leaves a square adjacent to a creature without shifting, or makes a ranged/area attack next to it, whisper a chat card to that creature's controller with a button for the opportunity attack.

autoMoveActions.Name: Moving a token spends move actions
autoMoveActions.Hint: On a combatant's own turn, dragging its token spends a move action (walk speed per move action, shift speed for shifts; standard actions are traded when needed). Teleports, undo, charges and GM-dragged player tokens are ignored.

reactionPrompts.Name: Triggered power prompts
reactionPrompts.Hint: Offer powers with a Trigger (Elven Accuracy, Fox's Cunning, Furious Assault, Swift Charge, Infernal Wrath, and any power or monster power with a similar trigger) as a whispered chat card when the trigger happens.

damageTargets.Name: Apply damage to the attack's targets
damageTargets.Hint: Damage cards get buttons that apply damage to the targets of the original attack (players' clicks are applied by the GM), to the selected tokens, and a Retarget button.

powerRiders.Name: Power riders on hit
powerRiders.Hint: Apply Vicious Mockery, Dreadful Word, Curse of the Dark Dream and Stirring Shout to hit targets (with attack/defense penalties), heal allies who hit a Stirring Shout target, and offer Great Cleave's extra damage.

primeShot.Name: Prime Shot
primeShot.Hint: +1 to ranged attack rolls for characters with Prime Shot when no ally is nearer to the target.

tempHpFeatures.Name: Temporary HP features
tempHpFeatures.Hint: Rageblood Vigor (automatic when your attack drops an enemy), Half-Orc Resilience (automatic the first time you are bloodied in an encounter) and Virtue of Valor (card for the bard when an ally within 5 squares bloodies or drops an enemy).

classFeatures.Name: Class, racial and feat rules
classFeatures.Hint: Bloodhunt (+1 racial vs bloodied foes), Defensive Mobility (+2 AC vs opportunity attacks), Shadow Walk (concealment after moving 3 squares), Rampage (free melee basic attack after a critical hit) and Words of Friendship (+5 to the next Diplomacy check).

sheetModHighlights.Name: Highlight modified defences on sheets
sheetModHighlights.Hint: Colour defences changed by temporary effects (red = penalty, green = bonus) and list the effects in their tooltip.

readableRolls.Name: Readable roll breakdowns in chat
readableRolls.Hint: Replace the roll variables in chat (@wepAttack, @powerMod...) with labels and values, and show the module's automatic modifiers.

conditionalRiders.Name: Conditional damage and roll riders
conditionalRiders.Hint: Infernal Wrath rolls its fire damage; Dire Radiance deals its extra damage when the target moves closer; Elven Accuracy rerolls your last attack; Fox's Cunning and Fate of the Void add their bonus to the next attack.

clickMovement.Name: Click-to-move squares
clickMovement.Hint: Highlight the squares for shifts and push / pull / slide, then click to move. Hit riders open automatically after the roll; skipping leaves a button in chat.

powerLevels.Name: Automation and translation symbols
powerLevels.Hint: Show the ◆ automation and ■ translation level next to power names in sheets and chat cards. The GM can click a symbol to set it.

Warn.NoGM: No GM is connected, so the effect on {name} can't be applied.
Warn.OneTarget: {power}: target only one creature (or none, to pick the nearest enemy).
Warn.NotNearest: {power}: {target} isn't the nearest enemy you can see (nearest is {distance} squares away). Applied anyway.
Warn.NoSourceToken: Place and select your token on the scene first.
Warn.AlreadyCursed: {target} is already under a Warlock's Curse.
Warn.NoAllyInRange: Misdirected Mark: no ally within 5 squares to be the marker.

Info.FuriousAssaultArmed: {name}: Furious Assault armed, the extra damage will appear in the next damage roll.

Dialog.ChooseNearestHint: These enemies are tied for the nearest. Which one?
Dialog.ChooseMarkerHint: Choose an ally within 5 squares of you.

Effect.QuarryDesc: {source}'s Hunter's Quarry. Lasts until the end of the encounter, until this creature is defeated, or until a new quarry is designated.
Effect.CurseDesc: {source}'s Warlock's Curse. Lasts until the end of the encounter or until this creature drops to 0 hit points.
Effect.MarkDesc: Marked by {source} ({power}): -2 to attack rolls that don't include {source}.
Effect.FateDesc: +bonus to one d20 roll during your next turn. Lost if unused.

Chat.RageManual: This rage's ongoing benefit isn't automated yet; apply it by hand.
Chat.FateOfTheVoid: {target} fell under {actor}'s curse: Fate of the Void, +{bonus} to one d20 roll during your next turn.

Damage.QuarryUsed: Already dealt since the start of your turn.
Damage.BloodhuntActive: You or the target is bloodied.
Damage.BloodhuntInactive: Neither you nor the target is bloodied.
Damage.RagingBonusHint: Extra damage because you are raging.
Damage.FuriousAssaultHint: Extra damage from Furious Assault (1[W] for weapon attacks, 1d8 otherwise).

Actions.NoCombatant: Select a token that is in combat.
Actions.WarnNone: {name} has no {action} action left this turn.
Actions.WarnNotYourTurn: {name}: {action} actions are only taken on your own turn.
Actions.WarnImmediateOwnTurn: {name}: immediate actions can't be taken on your own turn.
Actions.WarnImmediateUsed: {name} already took an immediate action this round.
Actions.WarnOpportunityOwnTurn: {name}: opportunity actions can't be taken on your own turn.
Actions.WarnOpportunityUsed: {name} already took an opportunity action this turn.
Actions.WarnSecondWindUsed: {name} already used Second Wind this encounter.

Chat.run: {name} runs (−5 to attacks, grants combat advantage until the start of their next turn).
Chat.charge: {name} charges! (+1 to the attack; the basic attack is part of the charge.)
Chat.totalDefense: {name} takes Total Defense (+2 to all defenses until the start of their next turn).

Actions.WarnShiftTooFar: {name} shifted {squares} squares but can only shift {budget}.
Actions.FreeShiftRefund: {power}: {name}'s shift was part of the power, so the move action is refunded.
Actions.FreeShiftGranted: {power}: {name} can shift {squares} square(s) this turn without spending a move action.

Opportunity.Title: Opportunity attack
Opportunity.ReasonRanged: {provoker} made a ranged attack next to {threat}.
Opportunity.ReasonArea: {provoker} made an area attack next to {threat}.
Opportunity.Note: Ignore if it was forced movement (push, pull, slide) or the creature can't act.

DamageApply.RetargetHint: Replace this card's targets with the tokens you are targeting now.
DamageApply.NoTargets: This card has no targets. Target tokens and use Retarget.
DamageApply.NoCurrentTargets: Target at least one token first.

OnHit.MockeryDesc: −2 penalty to attack rolls until the end of the bard's next turn.
OnHit.DreadfulDesc: −{penalty} penalty to Will until the end of the warlock's next turn.
OnHit.DarkDreamDesc: Subjected to the dark dream (save ends): the warlock can slide it 1 square as a minor action once per round.
OnHit.StirringDesc: Until the end of the encounter, an ally of {source} who hits this creature regains {heal} hit points.
OnHit.GreatCleaveHint: +1 damage for each enemy adjacent to you.

TempHp.Rageblood: {actor} gains {amount} temporary hit points (Rageblood Vigor, {target} dropped).
TempHp.ValorGranted: {bard} gives {ally} {amount} temporary hit points (Virtue of Valor).
TempHp.ValorNotHigher: {ally} already has as many temporary hit points; Virtue of Valor used without effect.
TempHp.Resilience: {actor} gains {amount} temporary hit points ({feature}, first time bloodied this encounter).

Conditional.FoxArmed: {name}: the next basic attack gets +{bonus} (Fox's Cunning).
Conditional.NoLastAttack: {name} has no recent attack to reroll.
Conditional.Rerolling: {power}: rolling the attack again against the same targets. Use the second roll.
Conditional.DireDesc: The first time this creature moves closer to {source} on its next turn, it takes {formula} damage.

Levels.ChooseHint: Choose the level for {power}. It applies to every copy of this power in the world.

Features.Rampage: {actor} scored a critical hit with {power} and can make a melee basic attack as a free action.

Features.WordsDesc: +5 power bonus to the next Diplomacy check. Ends after that check or at the end of the next turn.
